passage.text: I'm writing this at the airport, and my flight to Toronto leaves in an hour.
passage.reading: aɪm ˈraɪtɪŋ ðɪs ət ði ˈɛrpɔːrt, ənd maɪ ˈflaɪt tə təˈrɑːntoʊ ˈliːvz ɪn ən ˈaʊər.

passage.text: Thank you so much for the farewell party last night.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ fər ðə ˌfɛrˈwɛl ˈpɑːrti ˈlæst ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: When everyone sang a Thai song for me, I almost cried!
passage.reading: ˈwɛn ˈɛvriwʌn ˈsæŋ ə ˈtaɪ ˈsɔːŋ fər miː, aɪ ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈkraɪd!

passage.text: When I look back on my time in Bangkok, I think of you first.
passage.reading: ˈwɛn aɪ ˈlʊk ˈbæk ɑːn maɪ ˈtaɪm ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, aɪ ˈθɪŋk əv juː ˈfɜːrst.

passage.text: You helped me with everything, from my first Thai words to my first Songkran.
passage.reading: juː ˈhɛlpt miː wɪð ˈɛvriθɪŋ, frəm maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪ ˈwɜːrdz tə maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈsɔːŋkrɑːn.

passage.text: You were my roommate, my teacher and my best friend.
passage.reading: juː wɜːr maɪ ˈruːmmeɪt, maɪ ˈtiːtʃər ənd maɪ ˌbɛst ˈfrɛnd.

passage.text: I hope we'll always stay close, even though we'll live in different countries.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp wiːl ˈɔːlweɪz ˈsteɪ ˈkloʊz, ˈiːvən ðoʊ wiːl ˈlɪv ɪn ˈdɪfərənt ˈkʌntriz.

passage.text: Fingers crossed for your exchange in Toronto!
passage.reading: ˈfɪŋɡərz ˈkrɔːst fər jʊr ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ!

passage.text: If they accept you, you can stay with my family.
passage.reading: ɪf ðeɪ əkˈsɛpt juː, juː kən ˈsteɪ wɪð maɪ ˈfæməli.

passage.text: And after I graduate, I'm going to look for a job in Bangkok, so our reunion might happen sooner than we think!
passage.reading: ənd ˈæftər aɪ ˈɡrædʒueɪt, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈlʊk fər ə ˈdʒɑːb ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, soʊ aʊr ˌriːˈjuːnjən maɪt ˈhæpən ˈsuːnər ðən wiː ˈθɪŋk!
